spot.name: Greymouth / Hokitika
spot.notes: Main West Coast hub with good facilities.
spot.tide_note: Greymouth is a LINZ secondary port of Westport; times are Westport's

model_run: not exposed by engine (Open-Meteo best-match; see generated_at)
sources: Tide predictions: Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), CC BY 4.0. Not for navigation.

verdict.headline: Go Tue 5-8am
verdict.advice: Tue 5-8am, light NE 4 kn, 1.4 m sea @ 6 s, rising tide, high 6:28am, dawn - try blue cod: baits on the bottom off the rocks or over foul ground

species.name: Blue Cod
species.how: baits on the bottom off the rocks or over foul ground

species.name: Tarakihi
species.how: ledger rigs on sand/foul edges

species.name: Kahawai
species.how: lures or soft-baits on surface work-ups

species.name: Tuna (seasonal)
species.how: offshore trips only, in a suitable boat
notes: Recreational southern bluefin tuna fishery off the west coast of the South Island runs January-August (2024-25 season Dec-Aug; Fiordland usually starts in January; Greymouth catches highest Jul-Aug).
sources: Fisheries NZ, FAR 2025/52 'Recreational harvest of southern bluefin tuna in New Zealand 2024-25'. https://fs.fish.govt.nz/Doc/26187/FAR-2025-52-Recreational-harvest-southern-bluefin-tuna-New-Zealand-2024-25.pdf.ashx
